profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work on the API frontend of Google Cloud Storage.

I previously worked on backend teams for Google Talk, Google Maps, and other projects.

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description: Taught CSS 342 (Data Structures, Algorithms, and Discrete Mathematics I) for the Computing and Software Systems Program.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Interned several times over a period of two years.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Master of Science in Engineering - MSE, Computer Science (BS, MSE), Mathematical Sciences (BS)

honors.title: Outstanding TA Award

volunteerExperiences.description: I organize a team of about 20 volunteer radio communicators for training and public service.

projects.title: Ragnar Relay Team Organizer
projects.description: I ran in a Google team for Ragnar Relay Northwest Passage (a 200-mile running relay, 6- or 12-person teams) every year for a decade starting 2007. From 2008 to 2012, I was the team organizer, juggling up to three 12-person teams at once.
